_note: Replace <<slug>> and <<test-recipient>>. Add system blocks for whatever services this client uses (delete the ones you don't need). Hirobius never touches .env files; only env-key NAMES are referenced here.

outlook.notes: Microsoft Graph API. Per-tenant Azure AD app registration.

modeContract.test: All outbound (email, SMS, API writes) must target testRecipient OR be no-op'd.
modeContract.production: Outbound sends to productionRecipients per workflow. Requires explicit per-workflow promotion checklist.

llm.providerNotes: ollama | claude | none. Default ollama (local, free, private). Customer flips to claude with their own ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for higher quality. 'none' forces deterministic-only paths.

claude.billing: Customer's Anthropic account. Hirobius never sees usage or billing.
